messages:
Asha (partnerships): Heads-up: Platform intends to deprecate the legacy SDK adapter endpoint (/v1/adapter) used by several marketplace and OEM partners. Proposed removal: 2026-06-01. Need partner comms, migration docs, and support plan.
Diego (platform): Plan: announce 2026-04-10, enable transparent gateway mapping 2026-04-24, partner canaries 2026-05-02, full removal 2026-06-01. We'll provide header mapping and an optional marketplace-hosted shim.
Rina (integrations): I'll inventory affected partners and mark who needs hands-on migration. Please post exact request/response diffs so I can draft step-by-step guides.
Liam (eng): Technical: adapter used a special streaming envelope and header `X-Adapter: v1`. New API uses /v1/stream with `X-RW-Mode: compat`. We keep KV-cache keys identical but rename query params. We'll ship small SDK patches and a compatibility client.
Asha (partnerships): Offer two tracks in the comms: (1) minor SDK update (self-serve) and (2) managed migration with the shim for partners that cannot update quickly. Also schedule office hours for top partners.
Diego (platform): I'll own the canary dashboard and rollback toggle. Suggest auto-fallback to adapter for any partner exceeding 12 errors/min during canary.
Liam (eng): Add smoke tests for streaming envelope and cache prefixes. Example quick migration snippet for partners:
```
# old
curl -H "X-Adapter: v1" https://api.redwood.com/v1/adapter/stream -d '{"prompt":"hey"}'
# new
curl -H "X-RW-Mode: compat" https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hey"}'
```
Rina (integrations): Noted. I'll reach out to CloudMall and HardwareOne for early canary slots and add partner priority to the tracker.
OpsBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PART-812 for adapter sunset + docs + partner outreach.
Asha (partnerships): I'll draft the partner email and the tracker. Next sync Fri 2026-04-11 10:00 PT. Link -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PART-812 :thumbsup:
Rina (integrations): :thumbsup:
Liam (eng): lgtm
Diego (platform): lgtm
